Package index

Fitting a rating

Fit a multi-limb power-law rating by nonlinear least squares, and find breakpoints rather than guess them.

rate_optimise()
Fit a multi-limb power-law rating curve
rate_optimise_constrained()
Fit a multi-limb rating with junction continuity built into the fit
suggest_breakpoints()
Suggest candidate stage breakpoints for a multi-limb rating fit
suggested_breakpoints_vector()
Extract the selected breakpoints from suggest_breakpoints() as a vector
rate_from_cross_section()
Derive a theoretical rating from a surveyed cross-section (Manning's equation)

Weir and flume equations

Physically-derived discharge from structure geometry, not fitted to gaugings, with GUM-style propagated uncertainty.

weir_discharge_rectangular()
Discharge over a full-width (suppressed) rectangular sharp-crested weir
weir_discharge_vnotch()
Discharge over a V-notch (triangular) sharp-crested weir
weir_discharge_cipoletti()
Discharge over a Cipoletti (trapezoidal) sharp-crested weir
flume_discharge_parshall()
Discharge through a standard Parshall flume (free flow)

The segmented alternative

A joint model with no junction gap to reconcile, after Hodson et al. (2024).

rate_optimise_segmented()
Fit a rating curve with Hodson et al. (2024)'s segmented parameterisation

Diagnosing a fit

plot_rating_residuals()
Plot rating fit residuals by limb
flag_extrapolated_limbs()
Flag rating limbs that extrapolate substantially beyond their gaugings
plot_rating_cross_section()
Overlay a surveyed cross-section on a fitted rating's own plot
demo_cross_section_rating()
Demonstrate a river cross-section against its rating curve

The junction gap problem

Independently-fitted limbs rarely meet exactly. Detect the resulting discharge gap and close it — by patching the table, rescaling a limb’s equation, or relocating the boundary to where the curves actually cross.

detect_rc_gaps()
Detect discharge gaps between rating-curve limbs
resolve_rc_gaps()
Resolve discharge gaps between rating-curve limbs
align_limb_equations()
Align rating-curve limb equations so junctions match exactly
align_limb_boundaries()
Relocate a junction to where two limb equations actually cross
plot_rc_gaps()
Diagnostic plot for rating-curve gap detection and resolution
expand_rating_table()
Expand a rating equation table into a stage-discharge data.table
graft_rating()
Graft a freshly-fitted rating onto a pre-existing one above its gauged range

Coefficient uncertainty

Bootstrap resampling, propagated through to a discharge interval.

bootstrap_to_table()
Convert a fit's bootstrap draws into apply_rating_interval()'s input
plot_rating_interval()
Plot a fitted rating curve with a bootstrap prediction interval
apply_rating_interval()
Apply a rating with bootstrap uncertainty to a stage series

Using a rating

Convert between stage and discharge, and handle a rating that has changed over time.

apply_rating()
Apply a fitted rating to a stage series (S7 generic)
apply_rating_inverse()
Invert a rating: convert discharge back to stage
apply_rating_versioned()
Apply a versioned rating to a stage time series
as_rating_table()
Convert a fit to gap_check's equation-table representation (S7 generic)

Comparing ratings

compare_ratings()
Compare two rating equation tables
plot_rating_comparison()
Plot a rating comparison: curves and their discharge difference

Shared generics and classes

One name per operation, dispatched by whichever representation you’re holding.

rating_plot()
Plot a fitted rating curve (S7 generic)
plot_rating_curves()
Overlay multiple fitted ratings' curves for quick comparison
FlodeRatingBase()
Abstract base class for a fitted rating (S7)
FlodeRating()
A fitted multi-limb rating curve (S7)
FlodeSegmentedRating()
A fitted segmented rating curve, Hodson et al. (2024) parameterisation (S7)
FlodeRatingTable()
A rating equation table (S7), gap_check's native representation

Interactive tools and demos

rating_curve_explorer()
Launch the interactive rating curve explorer
run_demo()
Run the fit -> flag -> expand -> detect -> resolve -> plot pipeline

Example data

station_gaugings
Spot gaugings for a real UK gauging station
